summary: Manage data quality, access, privacy and delivery risks with practical registers, lifecycle maps and mitigation plans. Explore the five-day course.
lede: Data project risk management helps project managers, governance leads and data professionals identify, assess and track threats to data assets and delivery. You’ll practise setting risk criteria, mapping data inventories and lifecycles, checking quality, access and privacy controls, and assigning response owners and escalation actions. Exercises also cover monitoring dependencies, reporting residual risks and mapping AI-related risks where relevant.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who coordinate data initiatives or make decisions about data assets, controls and delivery risk. It suits intermediate-level practitioners who need to keep risk decisions connected to changing datasets, dependencies and project plans.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with data projects, project delivery or data management is expected. No programming is required; exercises use risk registers, data inventories and assessment templates rather than coding.
